research.scope: Selected public product surfaces and client code. No external server load or transaction test.

browser.scope: Local Worker and real D1, two tabs on the same machine, observed rendered avatar and received movement, greeting, prostration and meditation states.
browser.oracle: Completed six throws, saw base and changed hexagrams and saved history. All 64 patterns were checked against independent sources.
browser.offerings: Created and cancelled a synthetic demo receipt in the local browser. API tests covered idempotency, key isolation, date and daily limits.

crowdSample.scope: One local sample in each view after the distant character mesh fix and asset load, on one machine. Results vary by view, graphics settings and device.

limits: Simulated characters run on each visitor's device and are excluded from live counts.
Offering receipts are part of a demo. No payment or temple fulfillment.
Oracle text is cultural reflection. The shared meditation window is a demo schedule.
